source.title_or_context: 9. 'What to do' and 'what not to do' messages from the Guidelines

table_assessment.assessment_notes: Isolated guideline-summary table containing sixteen normative rows across healthy adults, cardiometabolic risk factors, ageing, coronary disease, and heart failure. Multiple rows exactly or substantively duplicate disease-specific tables in this corpus, so it is not an independent table example.

header_path: General recommendations for exercise and sports in healthy individuals

normative_assertions.notes: Alternative weekly aerobic-exercise doses are preserved.

text_units.verbatim_text: At least 150 min/week of moderate-intensity, or 75 min/week of vigorous-intensity aerobic exercise or an equivalent combination thereof is recommended in all healthy adults.

entities.surface_form: increase in exercise volume over time

header_path: General recommendations for exercise and sports in healthy individuals

normative_assertions.notes: Counselling is conditionally used to support increased exercise volume.

text_units.verbatim_text: Regular assessment and counselling to promote adherence and, if necessary, to support an increase in exercise volume over time are recommended.

header_path: General recommendations for exercise and sports in healthy individuals

normative_assertions.notes: Weekly distribution and preferred daily frequency are retained.

text_units.verbatim_text: Multiple sessions of exercise spread throughout the week, i.e. on 4–5 days a week and preferably every day of the week, are recommended.

header_path: Special considerations for individuals with obesity, hypertension, dyslipidaemia, or diabetes

normative_assertions.notes: Exact source-visible LaTeX-like math text and all exercise dose parameters are preserved.

text_units.verbatim_text: In obese individuals (BMI≥30 kg/m² or a waist circumference >80 cm for females or >94 cm for males) resistance training ≥3 times per week, in addition to moderate or vigorous aerobic exercise (at least 30 min, 5–7 days per week) is recommended to reduce CVD risk.

header_path: Special considerations for individuals with obesity, hypertension, dyslipidaemia, or diabetes

normative_assertions.notes: All source dose parameters and outcomes are retained.

text_units.verbatim_text: In individuals with well-controlled hypertension, resistance training ≥3 times per week in addition to moderate or vigorous aerobic exercise (at least 30 min, 5–7 days per week) is recommended to reduce blood pressure and CVD risk.

header_path: Special considerations for individuals with obesity, hypertension, dyslipidaemia, or diabetes

normative_assertions.notes: All source dose parameters and outcomes are retained.

text_units.verbatim_text: Among individuals with diabetes mellitus, resistance training ≥3 times per week in addition to moderate or vigorous aerobic exercise (at least 30 min, 5–7 days per week) is recommended to improve insulin sensitivity and achieve a better CVD risk profile.

header_path: Special considerations for individuals with obesity, hypertension, dyslipidaemia, or diabetes

normative_assertions.notes: Restriction lasts until blood pressure control.

text_units.verbatim_text: In individuals with uncontrolled hypertension (SBP>160 mmHg) high-intensity exercise is not recommended until BP has been controlled.

entities.surface_form: adults aged 65 years or older who are fit and have no health conditions that limit their mobility

header_path: Recommendations for exercise in ageing individuals

normative_assertions.notes: Exact duplicate of a disease-specific table row in the assigned corpus range.

text_units.verbatim_text: Among adults aged 65 years or older who are fit and have no health conditions that limit their mobility, moderate-intensity aerobic exercise for at least 150 min/week is recommended.

entities.surface_form: older adults at risk of falls

header_path: Recommendations for exercise in ageing individuals

normative_assertions.notes: Exact duplicate of a disease-specific table row in the assigned corpus range.

text_units.verbatim_text: In older adults at risk of falls, strength training exercises to improve balance and coordination on at least 2 days a week are recommended.

entities.surface_form: Risk stratification for exercise-induced adverse events

header_path: Recommendations for exercise in individuals with long-standing chronic coronary syndrome

normative_assertions.notes: Risk stratification is timed before exercise.

text_units.verbatim_text: Risk stratification for exercise-induced adverse events is recommended in individuals with established (long-standing) CCS prior to engaging in exercise.

entities.surface_form: individuals at high risk of exercise-induced adverse events or those with residual ischaemia

header_path: Recommendations for exercise in individuals with long-standing chronic coronary syndrome

normative_assertions.notes: Individually recommended skill sports are the explicit exception.

text_units.verbatim_text: Competitive sports are not recommended in individuals at high risk of exercise-induced adverse events or those with residual ischaemia, with the exception of individually recommended skill sports.

header_path: Recommendations for return to exercise after acute coronary syndrome

normative_assertions.notes: Outcomes are recommendation purposes, not separately encoded causal facts.

text_units.verbatim_text: Exercise-based cardiac rehabilitation is recommended in all individuals with CAD to reduce cardiac mortality and rehospitalization.

entities.surface_form: Participation in most competitive sports with a moderate and high CV demand
individuals with AOCA with an acutely angled take-off or an anomalous course between the large vessels

header_path: Recommendations for exercise in young individuals/athletes with anomalous origins of coronary arteries

normative_assertions.notes: Against recommendation retains the exact AOCA anatomical-risk population wording.

text_units.verbatim_text: Participation in most competitive sports with a moderate and high CV demand among individuals with AOCA with an acutely angled take-off or an anomalous course between the large vessels is not recommended.

entities.surface_form: individuals with myocardial bridging and persistent ischaemia or complex cardiac arrhythmias

header_path: Recommendations for exercise/sports in individuals with myocardial bridging

normative_assertions.notes: Against recommendation retains the stress-test context.

text_units.verbatim_text: Competitive sports are not recommended in individuals with myocardial bridging and persistent ischaemia or complex cardiac arrhythmias during maximal exercise stress testing.

header_path: Recommendations for exercise prescription in heart failure with reduced or mid-range ejection fraction

normative_assertions.notes: ADMINISTER represents provision of an individualized exercise prescription.

text_units.verbatim_text: Regular discussion about exercise participation and provision of an individualized exercise prescription is recommended in all individuals with HF.

header_path: Recommendations for exercise prescription in heart failure with reduced or mid-range ejection fraction

normative_assertions.notes: Substantive duplicate of a disease-specific table row in the assigned corpus range.

text_units.verbatim_text: Exercise-based cardiac rehabilitation is recommended in all stable individuals to improve exercise capacity and quality of life and to reduce the frequency of hospital readmission.
